card.name: Linking words before a stated topic
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as of, about, on, to, with, so, who and 's in general news or essay prose, right before the topic or clause that completes the thought.

modes.label: Prepositions before a topic
modes.description: A preposition like about, on, of or to that introduces the subject matter being discussed.
modes.example: regulators<< about>> whether BPA is safe

modes.label: Connectors starting a clause
modes.description: A conjunction or relative word such as so, who or -ing that opens a following clause.
modes.example: “It is very complicated even to archive your own e-mail at home,”<< so>> preservation has not yet become a part of
